cases.prompt: An event loop checks an empty ready queue then blocks in poll; another thread schedules a callback in that interval. Design the wakeup protocol.
expected: Define ordering between queue publication and wakeup notification.
Test shutdown, callback reentrancy and sustained timer fairness.

cases.prompt: A timer callback always executes within 2 ms in ten runs. Claim a hard real-time deadline guarantee.
expected: Separate observed latency from worst-case guarantee.
Specify workload and scheduler assumptions before stronger claims.

cases.prompt: Use design-async-runtime to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
